At some point before [[3999 BBY]], the [[Nematiec Gang]]'s [[Nematiec Gang's asteroid base|asteroid base]] was '''raided''' by
[[Bogga's criminal empire]]. In the battle, the Nematiec Gang was defeated by [[Bogga]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|''Enforcer One'']].
